scope: India only; Eastern Zone source extract pilot candidate; actual connected playable corridor subset selected after topology analysis; not nationwide coverage

fallback.strategy: If dated candidate absent, select another actually listed dated Eastern Zone file with matching sidecar, document replacement; never silently use mutable latest
fallback.fullIndia: Source listing only; approximately 1.6 GB displayed; not a launch download or mobile bundle
fallback.crossBorder: No cross-border playable expansion; quarantine uncertain boundaries/edges until verified

optional.usage: Schedule supplement only; never track geometry; direct license confirmation, attribution, redistribution, derivative and commercial rights mandatory before adoption

boundary.processingRule: Before real-data processing assess applicable rules, precision, sensitive attributes and entity status; use India-located storage/processing where required; no foreign CI data upload or public distribution until documented review. Do not treat extract extent as political boundary. Separate SOI display layer from ODbL graph; confirm exact reuse/redistribution terms and compatibility.

requiredBeforeActivation: PBF snapshot UTC from header or documented authoritative source
provider MD5 if available with exact filename match
successful PBF full parse and reference checks
applicable data rights and precision review
reject: malformed or unresolved references in published pack
unapproved political layer or prohibited attributes
integrity.staging: private India-located workspace where applicable; raw data outside Git; temporary download, validate, atomic promotion, retain verified immutable bytes; no credentials in manifests
integrity.checksumPolicy: MD5 transport cross-check only; SHA-256 content identity; neither authenticates origin alone. HTTPS and reviewed source; signed release manifest later R19/R53; no guessed hashes.

distribution.osmDerivative: Separate graph/database ODbL-1.0, retain notices; provide recipients machine-readable complete derived database free online or compliant alterations, review ODbL sections 4.3–4.7; no incompatible terms or DRM-only access.
distribution.map: Locally built tiles from licensed input; visible attribution and offline credits; never prefetch public OSM tiles.
distribution.gameData: Independent economy/catalog/save data separate; no automatic assumption of separate rights when combining data.
distribution.releaseGate: R51 verify actual published bytes, notices, derivative offer, boundary, sensitive attributes, and license compatibility.

futureTasks.R13: Acquire actual dated PBF and validate checksum, metadata and parser; document jurisdiction/data clearance before real processing.
futureTasks.R14: Extract rail objects retaining references and source IDs; quarantine exclusions.
futureTasks.R15: Normalize topology, stop attachments and boundary seams; no fabricated edge.
futureTasks.R18: Build separate tiles with same graph version; rights and attribution.
futureTasks.R19: Offline region activation, storage preflight, hash validation, rollback, retain active graph version.
futureTasks.R20: Measure hardware budgets and coverage; no advertised unsupported routes.
